storyline.label: Web Search
storyline.latest_title: Cloudflare Introduces Web Search API for AI Applications

prior_narrative.tldr: DeepSeek priced web search for agents at /bin/bash.75 per 1,000 calls on Oct 17, making search a metered line item. A long-horizon eval paper followed on Oct 26.
prior_narrative.whats_new: A GitHub benchmark compares 4 web search APIs for AI agents on 30 live queries, the first head-to-head comparison in this thread.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Search API choice now affects agent cost and answer quality, and neither the price point nor the benchmark is independently verified yet.

status.detail: Pricing, an evaluation framework and a hands-on API benchmark have appeared, but the sources are thin and unconfirmed.

beats.headline: DeepSeek prices agent web search at $0.75 per 1,000 calls
Community benchmark pits 4 search APIs against 30 live queries

open_questions: Do the benchmark's API rankings hold on a larger or different query set?
Do other search API vendors respond to DeepSeek's per-call price?
Is LongSearchEval adopted to compare search-agent systems?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Run your own production queries against your current search API and one alternative, tracking cost per 1,000 calls and answer quality before switching.

day_captions.dd757ca1b3c6b43c: Sets a concrete per-call price for agent web search.
day_captions.5f97c21b490b1ce9: Adds an evaluation framework that localizes failures in multi-step search.
day_captions.e3636bb8c76777d4: First hands-on comparison of search APIs on live queries.
